crit_title: Live data-safety defects — proven, unfixed, now committed

defects.title: Ledger exclusion is case-sensitive on a case-insensitive filesystem
defects.body: A ledger whose directory entry reads .ORIGINAL_NAMES.JSON bypasses `p.name != LEDGER_FILENAME`, gets renamed away, and update_ledger then writes a fresh empty ledger — permanently orphaning every prior batch's original-filename mapping. Same flaw on the .manifests check. The module already has _casefold_key for exactly this.
defects.repro:
was the case-variant ledger PLANNED for rename? True
HISTORY LOST: True

defects.title: Marker scan drops a real second fluorophore
defects.body: re.search yields one candidate per alias. When that candidate is nested inside a longer alias's span the overlap rule discards it, leaving none for the alias's own later occurrence — so a genuine dye vanishes from the filename, depending on channel order. Fix is re.finditer.
defects.repro:
'ch1 ATTO 647-N ch2 ATTO 647' → ATTO647N        (channel 2 lost)
'ch1 ATTO 647 ch2 ATTO 647-N' → ATTO647-ATTO647N (correct)
